title: Q homotopy shrinking inside an open
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], i an integer, r≥0, and Q the single complex [def-pc-derived-category] with the free rank-r O_Y-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] in degree i. Fix y∈V and endomorphisms c,e of Q restricted to V. Suppose their termwise pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV are homotopic. For any U≤V containing y, there is W≤U containing y on which the direct restrictions of c,e from V are homotopic.

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs: local unit-entry cancellation and extension of the finite calculation; finite matrix homotopy identities after shrinking

proof.text: All differentials of Q and its restriction and pullback vanish. The homotopy equations therefore give equality of the pulled-back maps. Only degree i can contribute because the other terms are zero. In the standard finite basis, the difference of the degree-i maps is a finite r by r matrix.

Pullback along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem evaluates the matrix entries at their germs in O_{Y,y}. Each entry therefore has zero germ. The stalk equality criterion supplies an open containing y where it vanishes; intersect the finitely many opens with U.

On the resulting W all matrix entries vanish, so the maps agree in degree i and in every other degree, whose terms are zero. Homotopy.ofEq supplies the homotopy. For r=0 the intersection is empty and W=U suffices; the argument is independent of the integer i.

proof_origin.place: Explicit finite matrix argument split from lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-homotopy-pair-shrink, steps 1--3; this half is independent of the other map pair.

theorem exists_shrink_homotopy_Q_inside_of_stalk
    {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : ℤ) (r : ℕ) (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (c e : (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules i).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))) ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules i).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))))
    (hQ : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map c)
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map e)))
    (U : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hyU : y ∈ U) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U), y ∈ W ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).mapHomologicalComplex _).map c)
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE (hWU.trans hUV))).mapHomologicalComplex _).map e))
